name: Code Review
description:
[agent-type: sequential] Self code review + security review (7-category checklist).
Code review: re-read every C diff on the branch. Found and fixed one defect: a staged inbound connection had cli_serv->up == NULL while check_loop_and_lh() walks ->up towards &me for any candidate found by name/numeric (crossed connect or duplicate SERVER would NULL-deref) -> fixed in b294d88 by setting ->up = &me at staging. Verified spec checklist: staged link never reaches SetServer/me->down/SERVER_HANDLER before server_complete(); exit of a staged link leaves no server_list slot (SetServerYXX deferred) and hRemClient is unconditional; strict gate sits after tag parsing/command extraction and does not fire for non-staged clients (tests/cap/ green); mr_server_cap handles parc==1 and "" (test_bare_cap_is_accepted), buffers are BUFSIZE; P10 wire path unchanged (test_p10_peer_receives_no_cap, s2s/commands/relay/multi_server suites green); is_valid_numeric_mask() applied in mr_server and ms_server and accepts every mask ircu emits; P11.md grammar matches servcap_parse().
Security: 1 Input validation PASS - peer CAP list bounded by BUFSIZE, names <=63 chars in [a-z0-9/-], value copied with clamp; SERVER mask validated before any use; violation reason echoes only the command token. 2 Injection N/A (no shell/SQL/HTML; CR/LF cannot reach log lines). 3 AuthZ PASS - staging happens only after Connect block, password, TLS fingerprint/hostname checks; strict gate blocks every other command from a staged peer; user/websocket ports refused before SERVER handling. 4 Secrets PASS - cli_passwd still wiped before staging; test fixtures use the existing "testpass"; sidecar logs wire lines incl. PASS in test containers only (Minor, test scope). 5 Data exposure PASS - LS_NETWORK log carries peer cap list and server names only; oper notice names the peer and offending token. 6 Dangerous patterns PASS - bounded memcpy/strncpy, assert only on an invariant guaranteed by the caller. 7 HTTP/deps N/A - no HTTP surface, no new dependencies.
Critical: none. Important: none. Minor: sidecar stub logs PASS line in docker logs (test-only).
